dict.string: Twice-daily local mirror of JJ's memory dirs + workspace anchor .mds to /Volumes/DockVault/memory_mirror. ~12h cadence via StartInterval (43200s) per macos_startinterval_over_calendar rule (2026-09-03 conversion) — Calendar-based Hour=4,16 skipped missed times when Mac was asleep; Interval fires on wake if 12h has elapsed. A working day of memory must not ride on a single 4am snapshot (2026-08-31 ruling). DockVault-only per doctrine: memory dirs are personal-context + decision-log, never ride to B2. Uses rclone sync with --backup-dir for dated diff snapshots + 90d retention. Loud-skip if DockVault not mounted or launchd context lacks FDA.
